activity_summary: You noted the strap, still long, and the coffer, still twenty pound fifteen shillings and still shut. The letter to Anne waits until tomorrow, after the bells. You did not start it this morning.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the note and left the letter unstarted.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Named as the person the letter is for. Not here.
